タイトル: Powerful platform, but unresolved audio reliability issues
投稿者: Rafael チリのCEO 公共施設, 自営業 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Powerful platform, but unresolved audio reliability issues"
良い点: Telnyx offers competitive pricing, flexible APIs, detailed configuration options, and support for WebRTC, SIP trunking, call control, recordings, and diagnostics in one platform. The portal provides substantial control over call routing and media settings.
改善点: Audio reliability was the main problem. I experienced one-way audio, calls that remained stuck before dialing, and robotic or severely degraded outbound audio. The same problem appeared with two independent sources—Chrome WebRTC and an ElevenLabs SIP trunk—when calls reached the mobile network. Troubleshooting required significant time and many configuration changes. Some support responses did not match the actual integration; for example, I received advice about bidirectional WebSocket media streaming even though my setup used a direct SIP trunk. I needed a clear analysis of the negotiated codecs, transcoding, packet loss, jitter, and PSTN termination route, but did not receive a timely root-cause resolution.

タイトル: Great and simple integration for number masking and SMS verification
投稿者: Leandro Antú アルゼンチンのFullstack develop, tech lead コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Great and simple integration for number masking and SMS verification"
良い点: What I like best about Telnyx CPaaS is its robust and reliable API, which has made integrating their services incredibly smooth for our specific needs. We heavily rely on their number masking feature to protect the privacy of property owners and tenants when communicating with security personnel at gated communities. This functionality ensures that personal phone numbers are never directly exposed during entry authorizations or package delivery notifications, adding a crucial layer of security and privacy for everyone involved. Furthermore, Telnyx's international SMS delivery service has been consistently dependable for our global communication requirements. The reach and reliability of their SMS platform are impressive, allowing us to efficiently send notifications and updates across borders without issue. The combination of these features – the seamless integration via their API, the effective number masking for enhanced privacy, and the reliable international SMS capabilities – makes Telnyx an invaluable CPaaS provider for our operations.
改善点: While our overall experience with Telnyx CPaaS has been positive, one area that could be improved is the maintenance of their PHP SDK. We've noticed that it doesn't always seem to be kept fully up-to-date. For example, the most recent commit at the time of writing introduced a change that incorrectly set the baseApiUrl to localhost for testing purposes. This oversight wasn't removed before the commit was finalized, which means that anyone integrating the SDK currently needs to manually override this setting in their code to ensure proper functionality. While this hasn't been a critical blocker for us, it does introduce an unnecessary extra step in the integration process and suggests that the PHP SDK might not be receiving the same level of consistent attention as other aspects of their platform.
